title: REQ-SYNC-022 --all does not verify inflight_operation_id residual count = 0
description: REQ-SYNC-022 states 'After completion, verify members.inflight_operation_id residual count = 0.' The implementation of handleAllReconciliation at cli.ts:401-430 does not call findMembersWithInflightOperations or any equivalent query after processing all members to verify the residual count. The test INT-SYNC-020 at resync-flow.test.ts:261-282 only checks target='all' and processed_count=2, without verifying the inflight residual verification step.
recommendation: After the for-loop, query for remaining inflight operations and either log a warning or include the residual count in the result. Update the test to verify this behavior.
